notes: Every quotation is copied from the text layer of the document as data/fetch/verify_web_quotes.py extracts it (pdftotext with and without -layout, tags removed from web pages, whitespace and Unicode compatibility forms normalized), so the misreadings of the scanned World Bank report and of the Krugman copy stay in the quotations; the rows say what each misreading stands for. The rows of the World Bank report's copyright page, the signature of the foreword (p. vii), its footnote on China (p. 1), the sentence on MITI and effective protection (p. 308) and the timelines of Singapore and Taiwan (pp. 152, 154), and every row of Rodrik (1994), whose text layer is unusable, were read on page images rendered with pdftoppm; their transcriptions are in the notes between « and », and a reviewer checks them by eye. The misreadings of rows wb_soviet (p. 16, 'dearly offset': the page image reads 'clearly offset') and wb_hci_shift (p. 129, the heading's years) were checked on the page images too. The juan column gives the printed page and the PDF page. Young (1994) is the NBER working paper of March 1994, not the article of 1995 in the Quarterly Journal of Economics, which was not read; Young (1992) is the NBER's selection of the chapter with the published comments of Paul Krugman and Robert J. Barro and the discussion. Krugman (1994) was read in two JSTOR-derived copies on third-party sites, cooperative-individualism.org (the source of the rows, with the JSTOR cover page; SHA-256 dd1314f2c11b47dee826bd7645122480e452d333ace3602761960249ac6b8e51) and vault.hanover.edu (row kh_stalin; SHA-256 c6fcb3fb85ad5fa52747e912cd45e078161b053cadf677ea234db19d15414ca8), downloaded on 2026-11-12 and not committed; their text layers are the same OCR and misread a few digits ('y.y', '^.y'), which the book does not use. Hsieh (2002) was read only in its abstract on IDEAS. The web pages of brookings.edu, the World Bank's archives, IDEAS and the Taiwanese law databases carry parts that change between downloads; their SHA-256 are those of the copies in the cache on 2026-11-12. A search result offered as a copy of Hsieh (2002) on a Tsinghua University page was a one-page biography and is not used.
